title: Authenticate lazy-module optimizer profiles
objective: Extend optimizer profiling across exact current-source lazy modules with per-run multi-artifact authentication, cache-safe private observers, complete attribution conservation, and fail-closed sidecar validation while preserving normal production execution.

handoff.summary: Implemented authenticated per-run profiling of root and transitive lazy-module compiler artifacts. Lazy modules are compiled from exact current Python source under a private lexical observer before V8 parsing, bypass both writable and production precompiled caches without mutation, publish immutable source-map sidecars, and are attributed by authenticated Inspector scriptId with independent sample/tick conservation. Profiling is fail-closed for missing, duplicate, stale, spoofed, preloaded, overlapping, raw-JavaScript, and contaminated evaluator lifecycles. Route telemetry is bounded by aggregate key rather than invocation count and carries validated terminal guard reasons. Focused tests cover multi-artifact authentication, cache poisoning, transitive imports, lifecycle recovery, raw-JavaScript rejection, and an authentic class-group factor-base lazy module.
risks: The required architecture:check receipt fails only because this lane base has inherited native export inventory drift; the integration branch already fixes that shared generated inventory in commit dc4a1c60, so this task intentionally remains active instead of claiming a review-ready passing receipt.
Guarded-fallback and error route receipts require the shared terminal telemetry schema from integration commit 48c40c52; this lane deliberately does not edit the schema outside its claims.

An evaluator that executes profile-instrumented lazy code is intentionally one-shot: later evaluation, completion, inspection, or a second profile fails closed, and the caller must close it after the profiling result is consumed.
Authenticated source sampling remains a Node Inspector capability; browser profiling support is unchanged and must not claim equivalent sampling evidence.
next_steps: Integrate after commits 48c40c52 and dc4a1c60, then run the combined architecture and route-telemetry suites on the integration branch.
When producing workload envelopes, include every returned sourceMaps entry and its exact current-source record in sourceBundle instead of retaining only the root map.
Exercise the integrated six-lowering telemetry emitters against the aggregated observer and fixed guarded-fallback/error reason schema.
